test_distribution_from_tfp_normal: test the distribution_from_tfp wrapper with a TFP Normal distribution for sample, mean, and log_prob
test_distribution_from_tfp_mvn: test the distribution_from_tfp wrapper with a TFP MultivariateNormalDiag distribution and slicing
test_distribution_from_tfp_categorical: test the distribution_from_tfp wrapper with a TFP Categorical distribution using logits or probs
test_distribution_from_tfp_transformed: test the distribution_from_tfp wrapper with a TFP TransformedDistribution using an Exp bijector
test_distribution_from_tfp_kl_divergence: test kl_divergence and cross_entropy between wrapped TFP distributions and native distrax distributions
